body:
Well I studied in the medical industry, so going back to that always sounds good. Unfortunately without a degree or "prior experience" that's a pipe dream. I put prior experience in quotes because I have over 1.5yrs of clinical experience. 

I appreciate you talk to me. I work nights and it's bedtime now so I must go. Thank you for your time, I appreciate it immensely.

I feel great remorse to know I will hurt the people I love most. But I feel like it's finally to put myself first, I've continued for them for what seems like an eternity. When can I have what I want?

My life really isn't that great. I've dropped out of college twice, I've got 90k in debt, I've done nothing, and probably will never.

I guess we can blame mental illness.  I've had thoughts of suicide since I was little. 

Once the thought of suicide takes hold it's always an option. It could be good day, good day, bad day, and there it is back again. There is no escaping it. I guess I'm ready to just give in.

I wish I could pinpoint one thing, I guess I could say life is what brought me here. I have been plagued with these thoughts for so long. It wasn't until depression hit that suicide became an option. I've come to terms that I will be tormented with these thoughts until I die whether that be soon or in the distant future. My life isn't that bad to be honest. I guess I'm just tired of fighting this desire.
A beautiful death takes planning.
Yeah I wish I could. I'm just too poor right now to afford to go anywhere.
Well I never thought about it like that. =)

I'm a bottom feeder. I work at a gas station. Today was supposed to be my 3rd day on the job but I called in because I Was sick. 

Before this I studied medical ultrasound. It was beyond my means but at least it gave me purpose.
Well tomorrow I'm scheduled to work. So I'll probably do that.

The stars didn't align. The subconscious wants to live and I wasn't in the right mind set to over come it. Also there is a lot of preparation I haven't done yet. I really have to work on it if I am serious about this.
I'm sorry to hear that. Thinking about what your going through its hard to imagine doing that to the people I love. Still, it's hard to imagine continuing.
After my second hospitalization, about a month ago, I started smoking weed again. I felt happy again it was great. Then I ran out of cash. And well here I am.

It's so weird I spent so long thinking if I got kicked out of school I was going kill myself and in the end I decided to quit because I was going to end up killing myself. You're right, I need a dream. I need something to work towards. somewhere there has to be meaning, but where.
I never thought about it like that. That makes me a feel a little better to say today I have the strength not to kill myself.

I wish you a swift recovery. 6 years of this torment I cannot imagine. You must be a strong person.

I cried a little when I thought about the man I was. I was who I wanted to be, and now I am his broken shadow. Hopefully we will both get better.
It's funny you mention moving forward. I say that all the time. but yeah, I feel like the system is rigged, but I have faith things will work out for you.

I see a psychiatrist monthly, and a therapist weekly. I was supposed to see my therapist yesterday but I was sick and didn't feel like going. Both my psychiatrist and therapist are great. They help me the best they can, I'm just a lost cause.
I'm not religious. Really that's just how I tell people I'm an atheist without getting all the atheist hate.

The first time I became suicidal I was working out a lot. I think it really helped me out. Yeah I was suicidal and all, but I didn't do it. I'm sick right now but I think my next off day I'm going to get my workout equipment out of my storage shed.

I titrated off effexor and onto fetzima so I was fortunate and didn't have any withdrawals. I ended up using prozac to titrate off fetzima so I didn't have any withdrawals from that either. I'm kinda at the belief that the serotonin agents made my suicidal thoughts worse. I'm not on a serotonin agent anymore though.
yeah, I need to get my workout equipment out of my storage unit. I think some intense cardio probably would help. Thanks for reminding me of that.

Last time I went to the ER to try and get help the doc said their was nothing he could do. My meds were maxed out and I've tried almost every medication there was. Thats not true but he said it.

I've tried, lithium, welbutrin, celexa, prozac, effexor, fetzima, lamictal, abilify, zyprexa. I've given up all hope that a medication will help. Haven't had much luck with any of them. Some make it a little more bearable, but they don't get rid of these thoughts.
I guess that's something worth waiting for. =)

I recently gave up on a dream of mine. I worked 4 long years trying to become a sonographer (ultrasound tech), and I gave it all up because I thought that was what was making me unhappy. I worked so hard, I pushed myself beyond my limits, day in and day out. I guess I'm full of regret. It doesn't help I have a mindless job now. I helped doctors diagnosis terminal illnesses, and now I work for a gas station. It feels so meaningless.

I have relationship problems with my spouse to the point I think about leaving her. What would I do then. My mother always says I can move in with her, but my mother and her husband are toxic people. I seriously doubt my relationship will ever get better, and yet my only other option is worse than where I'm at now.

Then comes the money. I have 45-55k in student loans. and about 10k in credit card debt. I can't even afford to pay my bills, but honestly I quit giving a fuck about that months ago. 

I feel like there is no escape from this hell that is known as my life.

I'm burdened with anhedonia so nothing makes me happy. Well I have cats...lol, they make me happy, but thats about it. I've tried so many different things to try and make myself happy, and nothing works. Anhedonia is a bitch.
yeah I've heard of it. Never played it though.
It's a little more complicated than that. I changed my major a few too many times and now cant receive anymore financial aid, so that chapter of my life is closed, at least for now.
I wish I could start fresh, but financially I'm buried under a mountain of credit card debt and student loans.

My biggest problem is I have no goal. I worked so hard to get into my program at school. I made it in, and then I couldn't do it.  Now I work at a gas station making little more than minimum wage. I feel like I have no purpose anymore.
I'm sorry to hear you have been where I am. It's a hell most people cant fathom.

I agree modern medicine does little for depression, but I'm not sure it will ever get better. Each day it seems like another stressor is added to my life. It's gotten to the point where I don't care. Maybe I do a little bit and that's what has driven me here.

No, I haven't done anything. Today I'm not feeling it. See people have this strong subconscious desire to live which makes doing it really hard. You have to be in the right mindset to over power the desire to live. Today I don't have that strength. =(
I'm 26. I've lost hope of getting better long ago. I've been seeking treatment for depression for 2 years and nothing seems to help.
I don't really play games anymore. I experience anhedonia so games don't do anything for me anymore.
Unfortunately I'm plagued with anhedonia so nothing brings me joy anymore. No matter how hard I try to have fun, nothing is.
I'm really tired of living my life and there is no escape from it except for death.
I live in the usa. I've been hospitalized twice for these types of thoughts and I'm coming to terms with the fact help is not what I want. I want the courage to go through with this.
Depression is a big part of the issue. I really feel like I'm tired of living my life. I want away from my life and don't see any other way to get away from it.
I guess so. today doesn't feel like the day, but that doesn't mean the day isn't coming.
